tasks.label: App: stop dev server (3003)
tasks.command: if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then pids=$(lsof -t -i :3003 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill -9 $pids >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; fi

tasks.label: Phoenix: stop (6006)
tasks.command: if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then pids=$(lsof -t -i :6006 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill -9 $pids >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; fi; pkill -f "phoenix.server.main" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

tasks.//: Manual: the dev bundle is launched detached, so no debug session owns it. Quit first, kill second: a graceful quit reaches RunEvent::Exit, which stops the sidecar; SIGTERM to the shell skips it and leaves an orphan holding its loopback port. The pkill pair is the fallback for an app that is already gone or wedged.
tasks.label: Desktop: stop Duct Dev app
tasks.command: osascript -e 'quit app "Duct Dev"' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 1; pkill -f "Duct Dev.app" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pkill -f "duct-sidecar" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

tasks.label: Backend: stop uvicorn (8002)
tasks.command: if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then pids=$(lsof -t -i :8002 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill -9 $pids >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; fi; pkill -f "uvicorn server:app" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

tasks.//: One command for the end of a session. The desktop app is launched detached via `open`, so no debug session owns it and Stop cannot close it — without this, every desktop launch leaves an app and its sidecar running until someone notices. Touches only Duct's own ports; other projects on this machine are not its business.
tasks.label: Duct: stop everything
